Step 0 shipped: protect-claude-config.sh narrowed to the gate implementation and deny list only, ask converted to deny, confirmed live
Steps 1-2 shipped: deny pruned to D1-D5 only; all ask rules retired and hook ask branches converted to checkpoint-and-allow or block
Steps 3-4 shipped: broad Bash allow plus mcp__* coverage; settings.local.json truncated to reusable prefix rules and accumulation stopped at source
Layer 1 shipped whole: temp-index checkpoint, rm-to-trash rewrite, hourly APFS snapshot, and the D2 age-based reaper in the same change
Layer 3 shipped: one PreToolUse gate, P0-P6 in order, allow/block only, fail-open except P1/P2/P5, honoring the D3 local-container carve-out
Layer 4 shipped: append-only tool-call audit log plus a SessionStart heartbeat asserting layers 0 and 1 and the promotion pointer
Layer 0 shipped: sandbox enabled with failIfUnavailable, gated on the U3 result
Steps 8-9 shipped: inert and harmful hooks deleted; logbook plugin fail-closed guard disabled or patched (R6)

One PR per MSP opened through the centralized pr-create tool, each leaving its base branch green

spine.active_goal: Implement the ratified maximum-autonomy permission architecture end to end: experiments first, then the ordered change set, one PR per MSP.
spine.next_step: Wave 0 is complete; two follow-ups pending (whether the sandbox can contain the filesystem without the network, and whether --settings merges or replaces). When they land, bring the user the full amendment set with evidence per item and get a ruling BEFORE any implementation. The SPEC cannot be implemented as written: Layer 0, Step 3 and D6's mechanism are all refuted or damaged. Steps 1, 2, 4, 8 and the hook work are unaffected and shippable.
spine.last_session: Ran Wave 0. U4 and U5 verified; U1, U2 and U6 verified with surprises; U3 refuted Layer 0. Mapped the promotion pipeline, the settings-ownership model, every registered hook and all 47 deny entries. Nothing implemented.

open_risks.text: Layer 0 is refuted — the sandbox blocks loopback and no allowlist can reach it, while on defaults a denied command is silently re-run unsandboxed and reported as succeeded, so containment is illusory exactly where it matters

A broad Bash(*) allow is silently discarded in auto mode and the command falls through to the classifier — Step 3 as written yields strictly less autonomy than enumerated narrow prefixes, and the rejection is visible only at debug level

The temp-index checkpoint captures nested repos as empty gitlinks — the eight worktrees holding agent work are captured not at all, and plain add -A silently drops tracked-but-ignored files so --force is a correctness requirement

Rollback undoes itself — converge promotes whenever live differs from local main, so a rolled-back release is re-promoted at the next session start or stop unless a human also moves the main pointer back

A PR that omits the hooks key strips every hook from live and passes validation — repo-owned absence means deletion, converge itself is removed, and permissions.deny has the identical shape, which Step 1 edits directly

Unclassified settings keys land once then freeze — sandbox, defaultMode and permissions.ask ship on first introduction, after which live wins permanently and every later repo revision is silently inert

key_decisions.title: D2 guards the live installed copy, not version-controlled source
